WCD_calculation.equation: WCD = (H_s + 2) * T_cycle  +  (serialization_per_link * links)  +  (propagation_per_link * links)  +  (switch_delay_per_switch * H_s)  +  sync_error
notes: CQF adds one full cycle of waiting at each switch egress plus one cycle at the source and one at the destination → (H_s+2)·T_cycle
Cut-through switching keeps the same serialization delay on every link
Propagation and internal switch delays are additive per hop
Time-synchronisation error is added once system-wide
Offsets are taken 0 at the talker, therefore worst–case queuing is the term (H_s+2)·T_cycle
